system.description: Once per scene, when a friendly PC completes a Clock with a successful Check or an elite-or-higher enemy first enters Crisis, choose one: every friendly PC recovers (SL × 4) HP or MP, each choosing which (SL × 6 at level 40+); every friendly PC recovers from up to (SL) statuses; or the triggering character gains +(SL) to their next Check.
